reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: turn verified property facts into a Seedance 2.0 showcase sequence
neutralIntentExamples: create a five-shot property video brief from verified room facts and listing photos
turn those property details into a buyer-focused Seedance prompt with a strong opening hook
inputs: property facts, room photos, architectural style, target buyer, duration
operations: map the property archetype to a 2-second hook, spatial camera path, lighting, and shot order
outputs: shot-by-shot Seedance prompt and platform-ready property video brief
failureBehavior: stop when facts or visuals are missing; mark invented scenery as unsupported
exclusions: does not verify listing facts, publish ads, or promise buyer response
usefulInvariants: keep room geometry and disclosed features distinct from cinematic embellishment
materialRisks: fabricated amenities, misleading perspective, and model-version drift

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: assemble GEO audit artifacts into a scored client report
neutralIntentExamples: turn audit outputs into a GEO readiness report for a marketing leader
rank AI visibility findings into a client-ready scorecard and action roadmap
inputs: audit markdown files, domain, component scores, findings, date
operations: weight component scores, translate technical findings into business impact, rank actions
outputs: executive summary, visibility dashboard, score, prioritized action plan
failureBehavior: flag absent audit inputs and leave unsupported score components unresolved
exclusions: does not run audits or certify search visibility
usefulInvariants: every score maps to named evidence and every action has priority
materialRisks: weak audit inputs can create false precision

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: decide whether an RFP merits a bid and map proof to requirements
neutralIntentExamples: map mandatory RFP requirements to evidence and choose bid, no-bid, or partner-bid
build a Shipley-style proof matrix that exposes unsupported requirements and win themes
inputs: RFP sections, mandatory/weighted/nice-to-have labels, company proof points, win themes
operations: parse requirements, score fit, surface gaps, ladder themes, estimate scenarios
outputs: requirement-proof matrix, gap list, win themes, bid/no-bid recommendation
failureBehavior: no-bid or partner-bid when mandatory proof is absent; never invent claims
exclusions: does not draft final collateral or redline contracts
usefulInvariants: mandatory requirements remain separate from weighted preferences
materialRisks: optimistic proof mapping and invented evidence can distort pursuit cost

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: convert a GEO markdown report into a styled PDF
neutralIntentExamples: render a GEO audit markdown file as a polished PDF with a cover and 90-day plan
troubleshoot a failed pandoc or Chrome report build from its missing prerequisite
inputs: GEO-AUDIT-REPORT.md, metadata, pandoc, Chrome path, CSS
operations: extract cover fields, run pandoc conversion, render with headless Chrome, check output
outputs: client PDF with cover, colored score tables, severity findings, 90-day roadmap
failureBehavior: stop on missing report, pandoc, Chrome, or render failure and report exact prerequisite
exclusions: does not perform the GEO audit or publish the PDF
usefulInvariants: source report remains the content authority; rendering failure is not completion
materialRisks: stale tool paths and CSS/render differences can damage deliverable layout

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: design cancel flows, save offers, exit surveys, and dunning
neutralIntentExamples: design a cancellation flow with reason capture and eligible save offers
sequence payment-recovery emails for failed subscriptions without blocking voluntary cancellation
inputs: current cancellation path, reasons, pricing, payment failures, goals, segments
operations: separate voluntary from involuntary churn, choose five-stage flow, tailor save offers, sequence recovery
outputs: cancel-flow spec, survey questions, offer rules, dunning sequence
failureBehavior: ask for missing business context; avoid a save offer when reason or eligibility is unknown
exclusions: does not own customer health scoring or silently charge customers
usefulInvariants: cancellation remains possible and survey answers do not gate access
materialRisks: coercive offers, payment retries, and biased reasons can harm trust

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: prepare a pre-earnings watchlist and bull/bear setup
neutralIntentExamples: prepare bull, base, and bear cases for a company’s next earnings release

usefulInvariants: estimate, scenario, and observed fact stay distinct

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: improve a site’s visibility in AI-generated answers
neutralIntentExamples: audit a website for content that AI answer engines can cite

exclusions: does not guarantee citations or replace traditional SEO and editorial review

neutralIntentExamples: measure clicks and credential submissions in an authorized phishing simulation
write a safe simulation report that separates campaign exposure from real account access

operations: plan scenario, configure simulation, send within scope, collect opens/clicks/submissions, report

exclusions: does not conduct real credential theft or access systems outside the simulation
usefulInvariants: consent, scope, data minimization, and safety controls precede delivery

neutralIntentExamples: choose a co-marketing partner with overlapping buyers and assign reciprocal deliverables
create a joint webinar or content campaign with owners, promotion dates, and attribution

operations: score partner fit, choose joint asset or event, assign obligations, build promotion calendar, define attribution
outputs: partner shortlist, campaign brief, asset plan, KPI and postmortem template
failureBehavior: defer partners lacking audience overlap or approval owner; expose attribution gaps
exclusions: does not contact partners or commit spend without approval
usefulInvariants: reciprocal value, deliverables, owners, and attribution are explicit

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: test and version marketing prompts against cases
neutralIntentExamples: compare two marketing prompts against fixed test cases and a scoring rubric
version the winning prompt while recording regressions and output diffs
inputs: prompt candidates, structured test cases, scoring rubric, version history, output constraints
operations: run A/B cases, score outputs, diff versions, select production variant, record regressions
outputs: versioned prompt, evaluation table, diffs, regression notes
failureBehavior: retain failed cases and reject a winner when scoring is incomplete
exclusions: does not silently change production prompts or treat one example as validation
usefulInvariants: test cases and rubric stay fixed across comparisons
materialRisks: overfitting the suite and evaluator bias can reward brittle prompts

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: build honest competitor or alternative pages
neutralIntentExamples: outline an honest competitor alternative page from verified product evidence
compare two products with varied sections, explicit limitations, and a defensible CTA

operations: research claims, choose alternative/vs format, structure modular sections, compare limitations, draft CTA
outputs: comparison page outline or copy, evidence table, keyword and CTA plan
failureBehavior: leave claims unfilled when competitor evidence is weak; flag legal review
exclusions: does not fabricate competitor shortcomings or imply endorsement
usefulInvariants: comparisons preserve source dates and distinguish fact from opinion
materialRisks: defamation, stale prices, and feature-table oversimplification create risk

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: research NIH funding fit for a clinical idea
neutralIntentExamples: find NIH mechanisms and study sections that fit a clinical research idea
prepare program-officer questions after checking preliminary data, institute fit, and current NOSIs
inputs: research idea, career stage, preliminary data, environment, posture, institute targets

failureBehavior: flag non-NIH funders as out of scope and stop if core intake answers are absent
exclusions: does not submit grants or replace program-officer/legal review
usefulInvariants: mechanism fit follows evidence, scope, and current fiscal window
materialRisks: stale opportunities, weak preliminary data, and false institute fit misdirect effort

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: write an industry or sector landscape
neutralIntentExamples: write a sector landscape that separates market dynamics, competitors, valuation context, and thesis
compare public companies within a defined industry scope using dated evidence and caveats

exclusions: does not place trades or provide personalized investment advice
usefulInvariants: scope and data date remain visible; facts are separated from thesis
materialRisks: stale prices, survivorship bias, and thematic overreach can distort the report

neutralIntentExamples: sequence internal, alpha, beta, and early-access gates for a product launch
build an owned, rented, and borrowed channel calendar around a launch feedback loop

usefulInvariants: each phase has entry criteria, owner, feedback loop, and rollback

neutralIntentExamples: prepare an equity earnings preview with consensus, guidance, segment KPIs, and catalysts
stress-test bull and bear scenarios before a company reports

operations: build metric watchlist, compare consensus and guidance, model bull/bear catalysts, mark market-sensitive unknowns

neutralIntentExamples: build a four-phase SEO roadmap from audience, competitor, architecture, content, and technical inputs
prioritize keyword and content work against budget, timeline, and measurable KPIs

usefulInvariants: recommendations tie to audience, query intent, and measurable KPI

structure an ambassador or sponsorship brief with fees, content requirements, and attribution
